ActionRegisterTrigger.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionRegisterTrigger</Name>

                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>

                  <NeededProperty>Trigger</NeededProperty>

                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>

              </Property>

Attackable.schema:
<Property>
        <Name>Attackable</Name>
        <HasImplementation>1</HasImplementation>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
          <Name>AttackableType</Name>
          <Description>Can be empty! The type or role this attackable plays within the game rules that decide when it is attackable.</Description>
          <DataSet>AttackableType</DataSet>
          <AllowEmpty>1</AllowEmpty>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>MaximumHitPoints</Name>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Time</DataType>
          <Name>PausedTimeIfAttacked</Name>
          <Description>buildings get shutdown if under attack</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AlertRange</Name>
          <Description>If this attackable is attacked (or attacks) an enemy, it sends an alert to all ally units within this range. 0 = no alerts</Description>
          <Category>Attackable</Category>
          <Min>0</Min>
          <Max>200</Max>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>HPBarOffset</Name>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
          <Name>DestroyObjectGroupOnDeath</Name>
          <Description>If object is dead, the complete object group is removed</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
          <Name>OmitPamsyUponDestruction</Name>
          <Description>Indicates whether a pamsy should be triggered when this attackable is destroyed</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AccuracyWidth</Name>
          <Description>width of this object for accuracy calculations</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>DefenseByAIFactor</Name>
          <Description>how will the AI defend this? 0 - never defend, 100 - defend with normal calculation, 200 - defend with higher prio, even if 2:1 outnumbered</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>MilitaryDefensePoints</Name>
          <Description>Used for the AI to determine how strong their fleet / harbour defense is and should be</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>MilitaryAirDefensePoints</Name>
          <Description>Used for the AI to determine how strong their air fleet / harbour air defense is and should be</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Time</DataType>
          <Name>BlockBuildActionsAfterAttackDuration</Name>
          <Description>building actions: repair, move, destruct, upgrade are blocked after damaged by an attacker</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>MoralePower</Name>
          <Description>morale to prevent military takeover</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Asset</DataType>
          <Name>IslandWarFlag</Name>
          <Description>Morale buildings show flag when island war is active</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
          <Name>HasRuinState</Name>
          <Description>When buildings loose their last Hitpoints, they are change to ruin state</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>RuinSmokeParticles</Name>
          <Description>The smoke particles that will be spawned during ruin state</Description>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>FileName</DataType>
              <Name>SmokeParticleFilePath</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>RuinSmokeParticlesMin</Name>
          <Description>Min amount of smoke particles during ruin state</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>RuinSmokeParticlesMax</Name>
          <Description>Max amount of smoke particles during ruin state</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>RuinSmokeParticleRectBorderPercent</Name>
          <Description>The smoke particles spawn on the whole building bounding box minus a border area - this value states how big of a percentage this border is on each of the 4 sides.</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>ExplosionEffects</Name>
          <Description>When the building enters ruin state, one of the cfgs in here will be played</Description>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>FileName</DataType>
              <Name>ExplosionEffectFilePath</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>ExplosionEffectsMin</Name>
          <Description>Min amount of explosion effects that will play on enter ruin state</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>ExplosionEffectsMax</Name>
          <Description>Max amount of explosion effects that will play on enter ruin state</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>SelfHealPerHealTick</Name>
          <Description>building heals this amount of HP per Heal tick (currently 1 per second)</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Time</DataType>
          <Name>SelfHealPausedTimeIfAttacked</Name>
          <Description>building starts self repair after this time if not under attack anymore</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>OverrideAttackMarkerScale</Name>
          <Min>0</Min>
          <Max>100</Max>
          <Description>When set to anything >0, will be used as the scale for the attack marker instead of the mesh bounding boxes scale</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
      </Property>

Attacker.schema:
<Property>
        <Name>Attacker</Name>
        <HasImplementation>1</HasImplementation>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
          <Name>BasicAttackType</Name>
          <DataSet>AttackType</DataSet>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
          <Name>ShootingTracking</Name>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
          <DataSet>ShootingTracking</DataSet>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>BaseDamage</Name>
          <Description>The amount of damage that is dealt within one ProjectileSalve. CAUTION: Exploding Projectiles do not use this value</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
          <Min>0</Min>
          <Max>10000000</Max>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>ReloadTime</Name>
          <Description>How many 100ms game ticks does it take to fire the next projectile?</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>TargetAngleVariation</Name>
          <Description>how much can this ship variate his target angle without turning itself</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AttackRange</Name>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AttackRangeApproachPercentage</Name>
          <Description>Range percentage of attack radius at which ships will stop & shoot as well as at which shooting ships will start chasing away driving ships</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
          <Max>1</Max>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>LineOfSightRange</Name>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>MaxDistanceToPatrolRouteToBeAggressiveIn</Name>
          <Description>The maximum range we can be away from our patrol route to be able to start a passive attack. This helps to prevent use starting to attack an enemy when we are far away from our patrol route</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>Turrets</Name>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>TurnSpan</Name>
              <Description>Degrees (0 - 360), that the turrent can rotate (half to the left of its initial rotation, half to the right)</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>FileName</DataType>
              <Name>TurretCfg</Name>
              <Description>Config of the Turret (if none, no separate config will be spawned)</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Asset</DataType>
          <Name>ProjectileAsset</Name>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
          <NeededProperty>Projectile</NeededProperty>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Asset</DataType>
          <Name>TurretExplosionEffectAsset</Name>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>MuzzleEffectAssets</Name>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Asset</DataType>
              <Name>MuzzleEffectAsset</Name>
              <NeededProperty>Mesh</NeededProperty>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>FullVolleyTimeMin</Name>
          <Description>The minimum time (in seconds) it takes for all projectiles to be shot. This is only relevant for ships with sidetracking & turrets</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>FullVolleyTimeMax</Name>
          <Description>The maximum time (in seconds) it takes for all projectiles to be shot. This is only relevant for ships with sidetracking & turrets</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>VolleyMaxPerBulletRandomOffset</Name>
          <Description>The maximum time (in seconds) an individual bullet shot will be delayed by randomly. This will only be used for ships with side cannons</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>EmitProjectileTimeAfterStartAnimation</Name>
          <Description>The time between the start of the attack animation and the spawn of the projectiles. In seconds,</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>AfricaOnlyWeaponActivationTime</Name>
          <Description>!DoNotUseApartForAfricaPirate! [Can be removed for Limestone] Delay in milliseconds before Weapons are ready to shoot (needed for Towers / Turrets)</Description>
          <Category>AttackerToBeDeprecated</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AccuracyBase</Name>
          <Description>basic accuracy, width of a volley in tiles</Description>
          <Category>AttackerAccuracy</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AccuracyIncreaseOverDistance</Name>
          <Description>increases accuracy if you get closer to the enemy, describes the percentage of the shot width a zero distance, e.g. 100% accuracy does not increase at all if target is closer or 0% the accuracy increases to maximum if getting closer</Description>
          <Category>AttackerAccuracy</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AccuracySpeedDecay</Name>
          <Description>accuracy is lost if the target moves, at this speed it loses 50% of accuray</Description>
          <Category>AttackerAccuracy</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AccuracyBaseIncreasePercentage</Name>
          <Category>AttackerAccuracy</Category>
          <Browsable>0</Browsable>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>AccuracyByDistance</Name>
          <Description>Attack accuracy by distance. Please enter values ascending, sorted by the distance to the enemy.</Description>
          <Category>AttackerAccuracy</Category>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>AccuracyByDistancePair</Name>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Float</DataType>
                  <Name>EnemyDistanceRelToAttackRange</Name>
                  <Description>The distance from us to the enemy, relative to our attack range. 0% = Enemy is right on top of us. 100% = Enemy is exactly our attack range away</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Float</DataType>
                  <Name>CorrespondingAccuracy</Name>
                  <Description>The accuracy in % for the stated distance of the enemy.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Asset</DataType>
          <Name>WeaponIcon</Name>
          <Description>Shipyard menu shows icons for special weapons like airship turrets, flaks or flamethrowers</Description>
          <NeededProperty>Text</NeededProperty>
        </ValueDefinition>
      </Property>

Blocking.schema:
<Property>
            <Name>Blocking</Name>
            <HasImplementation>1</HasImplementation>

              <DataType>Integer</DataType>
              <Name>DeletePropsRadius</Name>

            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Integer</DataType>
              <Name>RemovePropsRadius</Name>
              <Description>for QuestObjects: Props are restored when Object is removed</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Asset</DataType>
              <Name>GroundDecalAsset</Name>
              <NeededProperty>Street</NeededProperty>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Asset</DataType>
              <Name>GroundDecalInvisible</Name>
              <NeededProperty>Street</NeededProperty>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Asset</DataType>
              <Name>GroundDecalAssetExtra</Name>
              <Description>some building need three different ground plates, use this setting in that case</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>OverwriteGroundDecalWithRegionQuay</Name>
              <Description>If set to true the GroundDecal as well as the GroundDecalInvisible are replaced with the quay decals defined in the associated region asset.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Asset</DataType>
              <Name>StreetOutside</Name>
              <Description>should a street be generated at the outside</Description>
              <NeededProperty>Street</NeededProperty>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>BuildDecalOutside</Name>
              <Description>true, if the ground decal should be placed outside of construction areas</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>BlockWater</Name>
              <Description>should only be true for objects which are placed completly alone outside of island zones and cannot trap ships</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>RemoveFromWater</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>DisableBlockingByDefault</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>BlockHarborFeedback</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>HasBuildingBaseTiles</Name>
              <Description>BuildingBaseTiles will be build if dummies are configured</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>HarbourAreaExpand</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>DisableDefaultTrafficFeedback</Name>
              <Description>If true, the feedback layer will not get stamped into the pathplanner. This is used for special feedback for e.g. farms where we dont want public traffic feedback but still need the feedback layer for specuial feedback.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>RemoveGrass</Name>
              <Description>You can disable the grass removal with this flag</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>BlocksBuilding</Name>
              <Description>if set to false, other buildings can be placed here. How the ovelap of the two objects is handled will be left to the developer</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>SuppressDangerToAnimals</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>BlockWhileInvisible</Name>
              <Description>Some systems ingore invisible blockers. Overwrite this behaviour.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>HasBuildableTilesBelowArch</Name>
              <Description>TLDR: Set True for gates. If this is true and our BuildBlocker is more complex then our BuildBlockerAABB, then all buildable tiles within AABB are only buildable for some other Buildings (see [BelowArchBuildHeight]). If false, those tiles are buildable for all buildings. This should be set to True for Gate-Buildings to prevent HugeOrnamentals or other Gate-Buildings to be built within. This should be false for L-shape buildings, as they can be intertwined without problems.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>ArchHeight</Name>
              <Description>If [HasBuildableTilesBelowArch] is set, this value determines the height of the arch, so only tiles with a height lower or equal can be built below</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>OverwriteBelowArchBuildHeight</Name>
              <Description>If true, the height of this building (when checked against another Arch building (see [ArchHeight])) is not taken from CFG-BoundingBox, but overwritten with [BelowArchBuildHeight]</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>BelowArchBuildHeight</Name>
              <Description>See [ArchHeight] and [OverwriteBelowArchBuildHeight]</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>ProvideLocalHeightForFeedbackLayer</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>ProvideLocalHeightForStreetLayer</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Integer</DataType>
              <Name>HarbourAreaSize</Name>
              <Min>0</Min>
              <Max>10</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Integer</DataType>
              <Name>AdditionalBlockRectSize</Name>
              <Description>the pathplanner update increases the update rect by this size to allow blockings outside of build blocker</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Property>

            </ValueDefinition>

            </ValueDefinition>

              <Description>The damage will be reduced linear from core radius to outer radius.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>ExplosionOuterDamagePercentage</Name>
              <Description>The Outer damage is [0..100]% of the coreDamage.</Description>
              <Min>0</Min>
              <Max>100</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>DamageExplosionChance</Name>
              <Description>The Chance [0..100] that this building explodes, when getting damage.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>DamageExplosionCheckMin</Name>
              <Description>A single explosion check is triggered between CheckMin and CheckMax Percentage of this buildings hitpoints</Description>
              <Min>1</Min>
              <Max>100</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>DamageExplosionCheckMax</Name>
              <Description>See DamageExplosionCheckMin</Description>
              <Min>1</Min>
              <Max>100</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Array</DataType>
          <Name>IncidentInfectionChanceFactors</Name>
          <DataSet>IncidentType</DataSet>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>BaseChance</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>HitpointFactor</Name>
              <Description>Adds the missing hitpoints percentage multiplicated by this value to the infection chance</Description>
              <Min>0</Min>
              <Max>1</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>DensityFactor</Name>
              <Description>Multiplies the chance to get infected from the infection chances of other nearby buildings</Description>
              <Min>0</Min>
              <Max>1</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>DensityDistance</Name>
              <Description>The distance in which other buildings are considered to modify the infection chance of this building</Description>
              <Min>0</Min>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>DilapidatedFactor</Name>
              <Description>Adds this value to the infection chance when the building is dilapidated / this value should be equal or bigger than HitpointFactor * 100 to stay consistent</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>FactoryProductivityFactor</Name>
              <Min>0</Min>
              <Max>1</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>FactoryOvertimeFactor</Name>
              <Description>factor which is multiplied by the working conditions [0 .. 1]  for this factory. </Description>
              <Min>0</Min>
              <Max>1</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>FactoryUndertimeFactor</Name>
              <Min>0</Min>
              <Max>1</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>FactoryHappinessFactor</Name>
              <Description>The avg happiness of the population level providing the workforce for this factory (Uses HappinessMin, HappinessMax and HappinessThreshold).</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>ResidenceSatisfactionFactor</Name>
              <Description>The chance to get infected based on a low satisfaction (satisfaction below moveInThreshold)</Description>
              <Min>0</Min>
              <Max>1</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>ResidenceHappinessFactor</Name>
              <Description>The factor depending on the happiness of this residence building. (Uses HappinessMin, HappinessMax and HappinessThreshold)</Description>
              <Min>0</Min>
              <Max>1</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>HappinessMin</Name>
              <Description>- (happiness - happinessThreshold) / happinessMin * 100 * happinessFactor</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>HappinessMax</Name>
              <Description>(happiness - happinessThreshold) / happinessMax * 100 * happinessFactor</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>

              <DataType>Float</DataType>

              <Max>1</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>ResidenceFullOvertimeChance</Name>
              <Description>when the people have to work full overtime this chance is added. The chance is multiplied by the average working conditions [0 .. 1]  for the population level of this residence.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>ResidenceFullUndertimeChance</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>

            <ValueDefinition>

              <Max>100</Max>

          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
